parameters.claim: H096 (P4-31) clause (a), stage G4: a BLM loss-of-function signature queried for reversers by entry 153's method, unchanged
parameters.mechanism_note: loss-of-function query: Bloom syndrome is biallelic BLM loss of function (PMID 28232778)
parameters.patient_data: none. Public LINCS signatures, gene symbols and drug names only; the gene comes from the case file, no clinical term is read.

test: H096 (P4-31) clause (a), stage G4: a BLM loss-of-function signature queried for reversers by entry 153's method, unchanged. Signature: top 100 raised and lowered landmark genes of the BLM consensus, BLM itself excluded. Compound rank = rank of its best reverser signature (SigCom z-sum; iLINCS concordance). Decoys: 20 random 100+100 draws from the same space, seed 20260925, through SigCom l1000_cp. Positive control: RMI1, RMI2, TOP3A gene-level mimicker rank in l1000_xpr, l1000_shRNA, pass at <= 5% of genes.
patient_data: none. Public LINCS signatures, gene symbols and drug names only; the gene comes from the case file, no clinical term is read.
list_rule: approved drugs (ChEMBL max_phase 4 or an openFDA label) in the top 100 compound reversers of both SigCom LINCS l1000_cp and iLINCS LIB_5
universe_rule: every approved compound present in both engines' libraries
join_key_rule: drug = mva.drugs.names.base_name(name.replace('-', ' ')): hyphens folded to spaces first; applied to ChEMBL's folded preferred name where ChEMBL knows the library label
caution: the registered positive control failed, so H092 is uninterpretable: this list is the step-10 rule applied to the run, not a supported result
